photos.c: Some of the younger Bels. pictured on the Common: Standing (left to right) Barry Everson, Keith Sinclair, Patrick Murphy, Mark Sharp, Nigel Streatfield, Mark Sinclair, Gerard Sexton, Graham Gardner, Alan Perriam, Philip Clay, Peter Morris, Brian Pritchard, John Searle. Kneeling - Mario Pederzolli, Scott Wyld, Simon Pritchard, Paul Thorp, Gerry Howden, Simon Howden, Kevin Sexton, Richard Streatfield.

Opposite page - the 2¼ mile race held on September 18th. Top: Raymond McCann holds off Mario Pederzolli at this point but Mario crossed the finish line first. Centre left: Gerard Sexton, first colt home,leads from Nigel Streatfield. Centre right: Micro-colt Kevin Sexton showed good form to place 12th of the 18 runners. Bottom: Getting ready for the start

Opposite page. The Philips 100x1 mile relay. Top right: Charlie Gillett. Centre left to right: Dudley Gordon, Gerry Sexton, George Piddington and Robin Brown. Bottom left to right: Simon Pritchard, Joe McDonald and Alan Painter.
Top right: A marvellous run came from Gerry Sexton in the Boys Surrey Championship - he placed 4th and earned himself a trip to the Inter-Counties.
Right. First year youth Gerry Sexton finishing in a fine 6th position in the same race.
Belgrave's Youths Team in the Surrey C.C.Championships. L.to R. Dave North, Gerry Sexton, Mark Waller, John Gladwin and Alister Horton.
The successful Surrey Road Team, Kevin Clarke, Alister Horton, Paul Richley, Stuart Paton and Gerry Sexton.
Right. Gerry Sexton, who has resumed racing after settling into his new job, has shown a remarkably fast return to top form, seen here also in the Surreys.
